role: counterfactual advance-notice component diagnostic, separate from the existing unannounced task
registration_context: conditional bound, six previous paths and cached information-coverage counts observed; the eight advance-notice paths have not been evaluated

information_intervention.meaning: both full request signs are stipulated known before the tail PN is chosen; these early announcements were not present in the public receipt history. This is an information counterfactual, not a causal forecast evaluated against the original information set
information_intervention.rationale: 90 minutes exposes the next call by the last nomination that can act on the preceding call's return and tail; it retains the original 60-minute PN lead and 30-minute nomination clock

component_roster.contexts: reuse both component_probes.contexts from basis_protocol, including exact first-call stock, first locked PN slot, original targets and the minute-960/1020 clocks
component_roster.pulse: original one-minute linear ramp, 30-minute hold and one-minute return to the locked reference, followed by its mandatory tail
component_roster.command_rationale: repeated export replenishes only the initially lower-stock unit; repeated import releases only the initially higher-stock unit; opposite calls retain zero PN. Fix these commands before evaluating the paths, without fitting capacities or searching commands
component_roster.outputs: compact continuous SOC extrema, final per-unit stock and shared gross power feasibility; no minute traces or weekly controller runs

decision: if all eight paths are physically safe, the advance information removes the tested local obstruction. Assess the justification for a distinct announced simulation task before any rollout. If a path fails, retain its exact mechanism; do not tune commands or launch a matrix automatically
preservation: all original request histories, information conditions, controllers and negative results remain unchanged; write this counterfactual to a separate directory
limitations: two saved states and four supplied sign pairs only; the information intervention is not historical BM knowledge, a 95-request causal-policy proof, a calibrated reliability estimate, evidence of source benefit or OR submission readiness
